A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete 13-page 3DGIC paper, including Appendices A–C and references. Text, equations, figures and tables support full comparison. The only visible difference is the first-page arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v1 reports original quantitative results in Table 1, qualitative comparisons, component ablations in Figure 7, and supplementary Kitchen results in Figure A8.

after.justification: v2 retains the original quantitative results in Table 1, qualitative comparisons, Figure 7 ablations and Figure A8 supplementary results.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Appendix A retain identical depth-guided mask inference, 3DGS refinement, losses, backbone components and Gaussian initialization procedures.

E1.justification: Both evaluate SPIn-NeRF, Bear from InNeRF360, Figurines from LeRF, and Counter and Kitchen from MipNeRF360. Kitchen already appears in v1's Appendix B and Figure A8.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains SPIn-NeRF, MVIP-NeRF, Gaussian Grouping, MALD-NeRF and GScream. Comparator membership in the qualitative comparisons is also unchanged.

E3.justification: The data splits, image resolutions, FID/masked FID and LPIPS/masked LPIPS metrics, 5,000-iteration optimization budget and testing procedures are identical in Section 4 and Appendix A.

E4.justification: Section 4.4 and Figure 7 retain the same Bear-scene ablations testing depth-guided masks and inpainting-guided refinement. Their configurations, images and findings are unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions report point estimates without repeated-run counts, seed specifications, confidence intervals or significance tests. No uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: All Table 1 entries are identical, including LDM-based 3DGIC's FID 36.4, masked FID 96.3, LPIPS 0.26 and masked LPIPS 0.028. Qualitative results and ablation outputs also match.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, projection and loss equations (1)–(9), and Appendix A's mask-refinement equation (10) are unchanged. No assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain identical claims about cross-view consistency, preservation of visible backgrounds and improved 3D inpainting performance.

C2.justification: The result interpretations are identical. Appendix C retains the same limitations concerning depth accuracy with sparse input views and SAM's difficulty segmenting small objects.

D1.justification: Appendix A retains identical implementation disclosures, including PyTorch, an RTX 3090 GPU, initialization, RGB/depth patch construction and the partial-DDIM schedule. Resource-access information and PDF link targets are unchanged.

R1.justification: Both contain the same 48 references and identical discussion positioning 3DGIC relative to NeRF, Gaussian splatting and prior scene-inpainting methods.

P1.justification: Only the marginal arXiv stamp changes from v1, 17 Feb 2025, to v2, 28 Apr 2025. The paper's prose, authors, headings and section organization are identical.

P2.justification: Table 1, Figures 1–7 and A8, captions and page layouts are unchanged. Rendered pages 2–13 match exactly; the first-page stamp update does not alter the layout.

improvement.justification: The scientific content, empirical evidence, reproducibility details and limitations are identical throughout the main paper and appendices. Updating the arXiv stamp and PDF metadata produces no meaningful gain or loss in overall paper quality.
